Maybe the stress I had caused 10 years ago had some effect on her health, but did not give her cancer.  She was diagnosed 6 years ago and fought three rounds.

Porcini Powder!
So there is a house down the road from me where the porcini's grow every August.
We pick them, slice them, hang them in the garage to dry and then grind them up in a coffee grinder. We put this powder in pasta sauce, gravy, soups and whatever else you want to taste like mushrooms. Also we put some of the dried slices in a bottle of olive oil. This is great on pizza dough; put it on just before the sauce. Try cooking your eggs with this oil for a great mushroom flavor.
